job.what: First construction of ibama-auto-infracao-recidivism (ibama-build-001), the READY candidate from the 2026-10-30/11-04 Latin America ticks, per the operator's actionable-build list and the record's pre-registered next_action (construction owned by ADVANCEMENT, standing order construct -> full-artifact gate 1.5 on the worker -> exact-byte acceptance -> reference triad BEFORE any model figure -> runner baseline). Task: at the instant IBAMA issues an auto de infracao (lavratura) against an entity, predict whether the same entity (normalized CPF/CNPJ digits) receives another auto within the following 365 publisher-local days. Population: one row per (entity, auto) instant, valid 11/14-digit entity key, full 365-day label window inside the pinned vintage; splits by lavratura year train 2005-2015 / eval 2016-2019 / holdout 2022-2025 (2020-21 enforcement dip excluded as context but still labeling; the 2026 tail right-censored and excluded, counted). The build downloads the CURRENT daily export and pins it (the 2026-11-03 probe vintage sha256 4db18814... is a nearby-vintage REFERENCE: drift recorded, never asserted), normalizes entity keys to bare digits before joining/hashing (LGPD: raw identifiers never shipped), dedupes on SEQ_AUTO_INFRACAO with conflict-refusal, keeps Cancelado/Excluido/Substituido rows in the population (their current status is post-hoc and never shipped), and computes prior-history features strictly earlier than the instant. In-build anchors: TP_PESSOA classification cross-check (exact, fail-loud), independent SQL label recomputation (0 mismatches required), row-ledger reconciliation, both-classes-per-window, written-files-vs-declarations verification, and a synthetic-zip fixture test (labels at the 365/366-day boundaries, same-day successors, gap-window successors, punctuated-variant entity merging, censoring, ledger) that runs BEFORE the live source is touched. CROSS-ROW CONTRACT: the entity-instant panel is structurally self-answering under row joins (a T+365d re-autuacao is a later row's prior-history feature and its own existence answers the earlier row's label), so quality.json declares access=isolated_rows with two declared reverse-history probes the gate executes over the full artifact (next_auto_gap_recovery via days_since_prev_auto < 365, and the ABS-style prior-count-growth window probe); the exposure is expected, measured and recorded, and the enforced restricted protocol travels with the artifact (nz-ea lesson). Post-acceptance score.py computes the pre-registered reference triad on identical eval rows only (persistence recency/count/count-rate, identity entity-history and auto-count-history, calendar month-rate and calendar-identity, global-rate, majority-class accuracy) with cluster-aware paired bootstrap CIs by entity and per-eval-year structural reporting; the holdout is never opened. The deciding rule was pre-registered in the candidate record BEFORE this launch: the full runner-contract model (separate baseline job) must beat EVERY reference on identical eval rows for any headroom claim; a reference matching or beating the model with a CI excluding zero on the deficit side is 'no demonstrated headroom under this protocol' and drops the candidate per the wb-loan/unhcr-corridor precedent. NO performance metric is computed before exact-byte acceptance; run.sh stops each stage on failure and preserves diagnostics.
job.stopping_condition: fixture, build, gate or acceptance failure -> collect diagnostics, diagnose, record; ONE rebuild per structural defect class is permitted, a second failure of the same class is a recorded blocker, never a blind retry. A reference-dominance outcome in score.py is a recorded measurement, not a retry trigger. The blob is a daily overwrite: a pinned-vintage change between plan and launch is recorded drift, not a failure.
